description: M4-01 + M4-02: a causal GRU-CTC phoneme decoder with a configurable lookahead L (fidetype.decoders.lookahead_gru), trained on Brain-to-Text '25 T15 neural data; accuracy (PER, WER, sentence exact) and trust-layer outcomes (frozen Paper 1 v4 config of M4-06, 'ours') against L; algorithmic and compute latency against L, end to end through the streaming trust layer.
dataset: Card et al. 2024 (NEJM), t15_copyTask_neuralData.zip, Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.dncjsxm85 (CC0 1.0). Copy used: Hugging Face mirror yw784/brain-to-text-25-competition, same SHA-256 as Dryad lists (Dryad file downloads need a login token).
normalisation: none added: the dataset features are already z-scored on the 20 preceding trials (dataset README), a causal estimate at trial level
targets: our CMUdict phonemisation of the normalised sentence label (fidetype.adapters.b2t25.normalize_words; SIL between words; trials with an out-of-vocabulary word are not used for training or evaluation)

splits.train: the dataset 'train' trials of all sessions
splits.val_select: dataset 'val' trials with an even index inside their session (checkpoint selection only)
splits.val_eval: dataset 'val' trials with an odd index inside their session (all reported numbers)
splits.test: dataset 'test' trials have no labels: not used

lookahead_rule: bins = floor(ms / 20): 0, 2, 5, 10, 15, 25 bins = 0, 40, 100, 200, 300, 500 ms (never above the nominal value)

shared.note: one model, L drawn uniformly from {0,2,5,10,15,25} bins per batch

trust.word_route: experiments/2026-11-10-b2t25-trust Decoders.words_fn (phoneme CTC prefix beam 64 -> PhonemeWordDecoder: CMUdict, word unigram, char 6-gram; lm_weight 1.0, edit_penalty 12, word_bonus 3)
trust.user: UserConfig.aac_gaze(chars_per_min = T15 copy-task speech rate of experiments/2026-11-10-b2t25-trust prep.json)
trust.note: The config was fitted on the PUBLISHED decoder's logits (split A of t15_copyTask.pkl). We apply it unchanged to our decoder (frozen = no refit). Its frame temperature and thresholds are therefore not tuned to our logits.
